title: Predictive L1 prefetch contract (L14)
description: Policy invariants for predictive boot-time L1 prefetch on compact-card-v1 cards. See ADR-026.

invariants.name: k_bounded_positive_integer
invariants.description: prefetch_k MUST be a positive integer. Default 100, profile-tunable.
must: type assertion: isinstance(prefetch_k, int) and prefetch_k > 0
default = 100 readable from this contract, not hardcoded
profile config may override via 'l1_prefetch_k' key

invariants.name: recency_window_bound
invariants.description: Cards selected for prefetch MUST have produced_at_utc within recency_window_hours (default 24) of boot time. Older cards ignored regardless of access count.
must: filter applied BEFORE ranking by access count
boot time captured as wall clock at prefetch start

invariants.name: diversity_floor
invariants.description: At most same_subject_max_share (default 0.10) of K cards may share the same subject_id. Prevents subject-monopoly.
must: after ranking, post-filter caps same-subject cards at floor(K * share)
if cap forces drop, lower-ranked diverse subjects fill the gap

invariants.name: decision_kind_coverage
invariants.description: Every allowed decision_kind (per ADR-024 CDC-007) MUST have at least one card in prefetch set, IF such a card exists in the candidate pool.
must: before final K cut, ensure each represented kind has >= 1 slot
if a kind has no card in candidate pool, skip it (no failure)
logged at INFO when coverage forces a swap

invariants.name: no_history_recency_fallback
invariants.description: When autogrowth_scheduler.stats is empty, fall back to pure-recency top-K (newest within window). INFO log, not WARNING (expected first-boot behavior).
must: empty stats -> sort candidate pool by produced_at_utc desc, take K
logged at INFO with message indicating fallback engaged

invariants.name: read_only_stats
invariants.description: Prefetcher MUST NOT mutate stats while reading. Stats remain authoritative for autogrowth scheduling.
must: no calls into autogrowth_scheduler.stats.set_* / .reset / .increment from the prefetch code path
tests verify by snapshot-before / snapshot-after equality on the stats object

invariants.name: missing_card_skip
invariants.description: If a card pointed to by stats is absent from the card store (GC'd or never written), prefetcher skips and continues. No hard failure.
must: missing card_id -> log at DEBUG, continue to next candidate
metric counter incremented (prefetch_missing_card_total) for ops visibility
no exception propagates out of the prefetch path

out_of_scope: Stats-source contract -- what fields does autogrowth_scheduler.stats expose? (separate ADR)
Adaptive K based on miss rate (future, not L14)
